description: Fork-update an agent of the installed plugin (by name, or id with `byId`): a new backend row gets the changes, keeping unchanged fields and metadata, and replaces the old row in the plugin in the same request; the server deletes the old row unless another plugin still links it. A `rename` to the name of another one in the plugin is refused (409, code `agent_name_conflict`) and changes nothing. Then regenerates the installed plugin locally, like `athenode init` without confirmation (the result adds `install` and `regeneration`, whose `pluginChanges` lists the tools whose plugin package or declaration was rewritten, with `suppressedIn` naming another tool's local settings file the plugin was switched off in; `missingEnvVars` is checked against the MCP server's environment, not your shell). If regeneration fails, the backend change is still saved and the tool returns an error. Requires an installed plugin (`npx @athenode/cli init`), unless `pluginId` names another plugin of the project: that one is changed on the server only, with no local regeneration.

byId.description: `identifier` is a backend id, not a name (CLI: --by-id).

identifier.description: Agent name, or its backend id with byId.

metadata.description: Metadata fields to set, as {key: value}; "<target>.<field>" sets a per-target field (target: claudecode, codexcli, cursor, copilot, copilotcli, opencode, antigravity-ide, antigravity-cli, devin, junie, kiro-ide, kiro-cli, kilo, factorydroid, grokcli, qoder, commandcode, codewhale, mimocode, zcode, vibe, rovodev, zoocode, pool, qwencode, codebuddy, augmentcode, goose, kimi-code, deepagents, omp, reasonix, bob). Booleans and numbers may be JSON values or strings; list fields an array or a comma-separated string. Unlisted metadata is kept on update.

pluginId.description: Id of the plugin to act on (see plugins_list); the installed plugin if omitted (CLI: --plugin-id).

rename.description: New name; the current one is kept if omitted.

name: agents_update
title: Update agent
